arguments.expected_measurable_effect: With holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.05 the complete simulation should show a measurably lower sampled final-window world-tip speed, ideally below the 0.02 m/s settling limit (baseline maximum 1.5810152739742807 m/s, F51; minimum 0.6351726092425104 m/s, F766) so holding_speed_passed flips to true, while terminal_error_m stays <= 0.01 m (baseline 0.007642608585867386 m, F14) and the sampled holding position error does not worsen. If the penalty changes nothing, the applied tension sequence (F576/F666/F527) and optimization_selected_iteration should be essentially unchanged, indicating the binding constraint is the solve budget rather than the missing tip-speed cost.
arguments.rationale: Diagnostic recommendations rec-defer-hold-speed-weight-comparison and rec-defer-causal-replay are recorded, not accepted as governing: both deferred solely because no saved-state check was authorized in the diagnostic phase and causality was unproven. This improvement phase explicitly grants one bounded complete experiment and states that missing causal proof alone does not prohibit it, so I select the candidate independently of those deferrals. Hypothesis: the hold-window tip-speed blow-up (sampled 0.6351726092425104-1.5810152739742807 m/s vs speed_limit_m_s=0.02, F13/F51/F37) is at least partly because no active tip-speed penalty shapes the settling nodes (holding_tip_speed_weight=0.0, F66/F733), so the applied input can stay near the seed plan (optimization_selected_iteration=0 at the displayed non-final updates, F659/F756/F673/F696). The holding term is the relevant lever because it penalizes nodes at/after the configured settling-window start (window_s=0.05, F65), i.e. the exact interval that fails, whereas a terminal-only term would touch one node; the terminal node is already inside that window, so terminal_tip_speed_weight is left at 0.0 and the single terminal scaled squared-speed term is preserved unchanged. Changing only holding_tip_speed_weight keeps the experiment unconfounded. Expected effects, stated separately: (reach) terminal_error_m=0.007642608585867386 m (F14) must stay within reach_tolerance_m=0.01 m (F42); slower arrival could help or, if braking is too aggressive, delay reach past tolerance; (holding position) lower speed should reduce overshoot/oscillation, so the 0.05813810428573256 m peak (F69) may shrink; (holding speed) the direct target: the normalized quantity (v/0.02)^2 is ~6e3-6e4 at baseline and should be driven down, with the goal of holding_speed_passed becoming true; (computation) an extra cost term can lengthen solves and worsen the already marginal budget (mean_update_s=17.26331904856488 s per 0.01 s period, deadline_misses=35, User_Requested_Stop=34, F55/F38/F9), risking further seed retention. Adverse effects: over-braking delaying reach below tolerance, tendon force-limit (8.0 N) saturation, added iterations/infeasibility; and, if the solver keeps returning the seed, the applied tension sequence may not change at all. Observations that would weaken the hypothesis: final-window speed unchanged with selected_iteration still 0 (binding constraint is solver/budget, not the missing penalty); reach failing while speed improves (speed traded for reach); or no measurable change in any sampled metric. Value 0.05: a moderate per-second weight inside [0,1] chosen so the integration-step-weighted holding sum is a meaningful but not dominant fraction of the tracking cost; no raw scalar objective is compared across weights. No local_comparison is requested: no saved baseline update with the required effective plan horizon of 0.01 s is evident (recorded effective_horizon is 10 or 5, F540/F470/F667), and local screening is optional and advisory.

recommendations.rationale: rejected: The deferral was premised solely on the diagnostic phase having no authorized saved-state check or complete experiment. retained: Causality remains uncertified. A single paired weight change with mixed physical effects (holding improved, reach and computation worsened) cannot attribute the reach/holding outcomes to any weight or mechanism, so the deferral of closed-loop counterfactual replay and causal attribution still applies.

Do not select improvement-96f0ade35119 (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0->0.05) as an overall improvement: the sealed comparison classifies it as a physical_tradeoff (F1522) and joint_reach_holding_passed stays false (F1104). Keep this separate from accepting/rejecting the diagnostic deferrals. Record the separate outcomes: reach worsened but still passes (terminal error 0.007642608585867386 -> 0.00869890424761182 m); holding position improved but still fails (0.05813810428573256 -> 0.05650455971948983 m vs 0.01 m limit); holding speed improved but still fails (1.5810152739742807 -> 1.1750052670100422 m/s vs 0.02 m/s limit, ~59x); computation worsened (mean complete-update 17.26331904856488 -> 17.77877309145406 s, deadline_misses unchanged at 35). Because the holding tip-speed penalty did not bring the sampled hold speed anywhere near the limit, treat additional weight-only tuning of that term as a low-yield lever on this baseline. If a further bounded experiment is authorized, prioritize the persistent computation/solve-budget and horizon-truncation observations (both untested here) over more weight-only changes, without asserting causal attribution. Recommendation acceptance is kept separate from controller-candidate selection: the diagnostic deferrals were premised only on absent authorization, and the improvement phase superseded that premise by granting and executing one bounded complete experiment, whose independent sealed comparison is now in hand. Reading that comparison by dimension: reach — terminal error rose by 0.001056295661744434 m (F1310) but both runs stay inside the 0.01 m tolerance (F1065); holding position — sampled max error fell by 0.001633544566242727 m (F799) yet remains above 0.01 m (F1212); holding speed — sampled max speed fell by 0.4060100069642385 m/s (F1563) yet remains ~59x the 0.02 m/s limit (F1605, F1185); computation — mean complete-update time rose by 0.5154540428891785 s (F1139) with deadline_misses unchanged at 35 (F1007). Since each run shows a physical improvement alongside a physical worsening and joint acceptance is unchanged, the objective outcome is a trade-off, not an overall improvement. This weakens 'hold.tip_speed_unpenalized' as an adequate explanation (the penalty moves the sampled hold speed in the right direction but by a negligible fraction of the gap) while leaving the budget-truncation and horizon-truncation hypotheses untested and hence unresolved, and it keeps 'reach_tolerance_exceeded' rejected and 'dominant_cause.single_execution' retained.
